name: yoop-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, LSP diagnostics, and lldb-dap debugging for Yooperlang (.yoop) files.

yoopiler.binaryPath.description: Full path to a RELEASED yoopiler binary, used for folders that are not a Yooperlang compiler checkout. Leave empty to auto-detect: a binary shipped beside this extension, then yoopiler_boot on PATH.

yoopiler.devBinaryPath.description: Full path to the compiler used for a Yooperlang compiler CHECKOUT. Leave empty to auto-detect: build/dev/bin/yoopiler_boot in the checkout (what `npm run setup` builds), then the bootstrap seed in .seed/.

yoopiler.stdRoot.description: Directory holding the standard library's core/ (YOOP_STD_ROOT). Leave empty to use this extension's own checkout when it is in one, and otherwise to let the compiler find the std packaged beside it.

yoopiler.runtimeRoot.description: Directory holding the C runtime sources (YOOP_RUNTIME_ROOT). Leave empty for the same defaults as yoopiler.stdRoot.

program.description: Path (absolute or ${workspaceFolder}-relative) to the .yoop entry file to compile and debug.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the compiled program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched program.

env.description: Environment variables to set on the launched program.

yoopilerPath.description: Override the yoopiler.js path used to compile before launch. Defaults to the copy bundled with this extension's repo.

lldbDapPath.description: Override the path to the lldb-dap binary. Default: resolved via xcrun / PATH.

skipBuild.description: Skip the yoopiler compile step and debug the existing binary as-is.

configurationSnippets.label: Yooperlang: Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Compile and debug a .yoop entry file with lldb-dap.
